category: Audio Toolbox II > Audio Plugins, Equalizers & Dynamics, Augmentation, AI Models, Features & Measurements
description: Audio Toolbox functions beyond basic audio I/O and MFCC/mel features: authoring, validating, generating and hosting VST/AU audio plugins, parametric/graphic equalizers and filter banks, dynamic range processors and effects, pitch/time modification, data augmentation, pretrained audio networks and speech services, spectral descriptors, and loudness/SPL/impulse-response measurements.

tools.name: audioPlugin
tools.description: Base class for authoring audio plugins in MATLAB. Subclass it, declare tunable properties and a constant PluginInterface, and implement process (and optionally reset) to create an effect that runs in MATLAB, Audio Test Bench, and as a generated VST/AU plugin.
tools.usage:
classdef myPlugin < audioPlugin
    properties ... end
    properties (Constant) PluginInterface = audioPluginInterface(...) end
    methods
        function out = process(plugin, in) ... end
        function reset(plugin) ... end
    end
end

parameters.name: process(plugin, in)
parameters.description: Processes a frame of audio (samples-by-channels) and returns output of the same size.

parameters.name: getSampleRate / setLatencyInSamples
parameters.description: Query host sample rate and report latency.

tools.example:
classdef simpleGain < audioPlugin
    properties
        Gain = 1;
    end
    properties (Constant)
        PluginInterface = audioPluginInterface( ...
            audioPluginParameter("Gain", Mapping={"lin", 0, 3}, Label="x"));
    end
    methods
        function out = process(plugin, in)
            out = plugin.Gain * in;
        end
    end
end
tools.notes: Use audioPluginSource for generators (no audio input). Keep process code generation compatible (no dynamic memory growth) so generateAudioPlugin succeeds.

tools.name: audioPluginInterface
tools.description: Specifies the user-facing interface of an audio plugin: its parameters, name, vendor, channel counts, unique ID and UI layout. Assigned to the constant PluginInterface property of an audioPlugin subclass.
tools.usage:
PluginInterface = audioPluginInterface(param1, ..., paramN)
PluginInterface = audioPluginInterface(___, Name=Value)
tools.example:
PluginInterface = audioPluginInterface( ...
    audioPluginParameter("Drive", Mapping={"lin", 1, 10}), ...
    audioPluginParameter("Mix", Mapping={"lin", 0, 1}), ...
    PluginName="MyDistortion", VendorName="Lab", UniqueId="mDst");
tools.notes: UniqueId must be a 4-character string for VST. InputChannels/OutputChannels can list several supported configurations.

tools.name: audioPluginParameter
tools.description: Defines one plugin parameter linked to a public property: display name, units label, value mapping (linear, logarithmic, power, integer, enumerations), and UI control style and layout.
tools.usage:
parameter = audioPluginParameter(propertyName)
parameter = audioPluginParameter(propertyName, Name=Value)

parameters.name: Mapping
parameters.description: E.g. {"lin", min, max}, {"log", min, max}, {"pow", exponent, min, max}, {"int", min, max}, {"enum", "A", "B"}.

parameters.name: DisplayName / Label / DisplayNameLocation
parameters.description: Text shown in the UI and units.

tools.example:
p = audioPluginParameter("CutoffHz", DisplayName="Cutoff", Label="Hz", ...
    Mapping={"log", 20, 20000}, Style="rotaryknob", Layout=[1 1]);
tools.notes: Use normalizeAudioPluginParameter to convert property values to the 0-1 normalized range hosts use.

tools.name: validateAudioPlugin
tools.description: Tests an audio plugin class for correctness and code-generation readiness: it generates and runs a test bench that exercises parameters, frame sizes and sample rates, then builds and runs a MEX version.
tools.usage:
validateAudioPlugin pluginClass
validateAudioPlugin options pluginClass

parameters.name: -nomex / -nocode / -keeptestbench
parameters.description: Skip MEX, skip code generation checks, or keep the generated test bench.

tools.example:
validateAudioPlugin simpleGain
validateAudioPlugin -keeptestbench simpleGain
tools.notes: Run before generateAudioPlugin to catch errors early.

tools.name: generateAudioPlugin
tools.description: Generates a compiled audio plugin (VST 2, VST 3, AU on macOS) or a standalone executable or JUCE project from a MATLAB audioPlugin class, for use in digital audio workstations.
tools.usage:
generateAudioPlugin pluginClass
generateAudioPlugin options pluginClass

parameters.name: -juceproject
parameters.description: Generate a JUCE C++ project instead of a binary (requires MATLAB Coder).

tools.example: generateAudioPlugin -vst3 -outdir plugins simpleGain
tools.notes: Requires a supported C++ compiler. Validate first with validateAudioPlugin. audioPluginConfig controls code generation options (e.g. deep learning libraries).

tools.name: loadAudioPlugin
tools.description: Loads an external VST, VST 3 or AU plugin binary into MATLAB as an object, so you can process audio through it, inspect and set its parameters, and test it with Audio Test Bench.
tools.usage: hostedPlugin = loadAudioPlugin(pluginPath)
tools.notes: Hosted plugins are externalAudioPlugin objects; plugin parameters are set in normalized [0,1] units via setParameter.

tools.name: audioTestBench
tools.description: Opens Audio Test Bench, an app for streaming audio from files or devices through an audio plugin or System object, tuning parameters live, visualizing signals with scopes and analyzers, and writing output.
tools.usage:
audioTestBench
audioTestBench(pluginOrSystemObject)
audioTestBench(pluginClassName)

parameters.name: pluginOrSystemObject
parameters.description: audioPlugin instance, hosted plugin or audio System object (e.g. compressor).

tools.example:
audioTestBench(compressor)
audioTestBench simpleGain
tools.notes: Can also generate a test bench script. Use -sample to open a sample test.

tools.name: designParamEQ
tools.description: Designs parametric equalizer filters (peaking bands with given order, gain, normalized center frequency and bandwidth) and returns second-order-section numerator and denominator coefficients.
tools.usage:
[B, A] = designParamEQ(N, gain, centerFreq, bandwidth)
[B, A] = designParamEQ(___, mode)
[B, A] = designParamEQ(___, Orientation=orientation)

parameters.name: gain
parameters.description: Peak gain in dB per band.

parameters.name: centerFreq / bandwidth
parameters.description: Normalized center frequency and bandwidth (fraction of Nyquist).

tools.notes: multibandParametricEQ wraps multiple bands as a streaming System object; designShelvingEQ and designVarSlopeFilter design shelving and variable-slope filters.

tools.name: multibandParametricEQ
tools.description: System object implementing a multiband parametric equalizer with per-band frequency, Q factor and peak gain, plus optional low/high shelving and high/low-pass sections, for streaming audio.
tools.usage:
mPEQ = multibandParametricEQ(Name=Value)
audioOut = mPEQ(audioIn)
tools.notes: Tunable in Audio Test Bench; graphicEQ provides ISO-standard graphic equalization.

tools.name: graphicEQ
tools.description: System object implementing a standards-based (ANSI S1.11) graphic equalizer with octave, 2/3-octave or 1/3-octave bands in cascade or parallel structure.
tools.usage:
geq = graphicEQ(Name=Value)
audioOut = geq(audioIn)

parameters.name: Gains / EQOrder / SampleRate
parameters.description: Band gains (dB), filter order and sample rate.

tools.notes: Use getBandedgeFrequencies and getCenterFrequencies to inspect bands.

tools.name: crossoverFilter
tools.description: System object that splits an audio signal into two to five frequency bands with Linkwitz-Riley-style crossovers of configurable slopes, e.g. for multiband compression or loudspeaker driver feeds.
tools.usage:
crossFilt = crossoverFilter(Name=Value)
[band1, ..., bandN] = crossFilt(audioIn)
tools.notes: Summing the bands reconstructs an allpass version of the input.

tools.name: octaveFilterBank
tools.description: System object implementing an ANSI S1.11-compliant octave or fractional-octave filter bank, splitting audio into many bands for acoustic analysis or feature extraction.
tools.usage:
octFiltBank = octaveFilterBank(bandwidth, fs, Name=Value)
audioOut = octFiltBank(audioIn)

parameters.name: bandwidth
parameters.description: "1 octave", "2/3 octave", "1/2 octave", "1/3 octave", "1/6 octave", ... "1/48 octave".

parameters.name: FrequencyRange / FilterOrder / OctaveRatioBase
parameters.description: Band range, order and base-10/base-2 spacing.

tools.notes: octaveFilter is the single-band version; octaveSpectrumEstimator computes octave spectra directly.

tools.name: gammatoneFilterBank
tools.description: System object implementing a gammatone filter bank on the ERB scale, modeling cochlear frequency analysis; used for auditory spectrograms and gtcc-style features.
tools.usage:
gammaFiltBank = gammatoneFilterBank(Name=Value)
audioOut = gammaFiltBank(audioIn)

parameters.name: FrequencyRange / NumFilters
parameters.description: Covered range and number of filters.

tools.notes: designAuditoryFilterBank returns mel/Bark/ERB filter weights for frequency-domain use.

tools.name: weightingFilter
tools.description: System object applying standard A-, C- or K-frequency weighting (IEC 61672, ITU-R BS.1770) to audio, as used in sound level and loudness measurements.
tools.usage:
weightFilt = weightingFilter(method, fs)
audioOut = weightFilt(audioIn)
tools.notes: splMeter and loudnessMeter apply weighting internally.

tools.name: compressor
tools.description: System object implementing a dynamic range compressor with threshold, ratio, knee width, attack/release times and make-up gain, returning the processed audio and the applied gain.
tools.usage:
dRC = compressor(Name=Value)
[audioOut, gain] = dRC(audioIn)

parameters.name: Threshold / Ratio / KneeWidth
parameters.description: Threshold (dB), compression ratio and soft-knee width (dB).

parameters.name: SampleRate / EnableSidechain
parameters.description: Sample rate and external key input.

tools.notes: limiter, expander and noiseGate share the same interface. Combine with crossoverFilter for multiband compression.

tools.name: limiter
tools.description: System object implementing a dynamic range limiter that prevents the signal level from exceeding a threshold, with attack, release and knee controls.
tools.usage:
dRL = limiter(Name=Value)
[audioOut, gain] = dRL(audioIn)
tools.example:
lim = limiter(Threshold=-1, AttackTime=0, ReleaseTime=0.05, SampleRate=fs);
y = lim(x);
tools.notes: Use a small lookahead delay externally for true-peak limiting.

tools.name: expander
tools.description: System object implementing a downward expander that attenuates signals below a threshold by a ratio, with hold time, used to reduce low-level noise more gently than a gate.
tools.usage:
dRE = expander(Name=Value)
[audioOut, gain] = dRE(audioIn)
tools.example:
ex = expander(Threshold=-45, Ratio=3, HoldTime=0.05, SampleRate=fs);
y = ex(x);
tools.notes: noiseGate is the extreme case with full attenuation below threshold.

tools.name: noiseGate
tools.description: System object implementing a noise gate that mutes audio whose level falls below a threshold, with attack, release and hold times to avoid chattering.
tools.usage:
dRG = noiseGate(Name=Value)
[audioOut, gain] = dRG(audioIn)
tools.example:
gate = noiseGate(Threshold=-30, AttackTime=0.005, ReleaseTime=0.05, HoldTime=0.02, SampleRate=fs);
y = gate(x);
tools.notes: Supports sidechain keying (EnableSidechain).

tools.name: reverberator
tools.description: System object adding artificial reverberation (Dattorro plate-style algorithm) with pre-delay, diffusion, decay, damping and wet/dry mix controls.
tools.usage:
reverb = reverberator(Name=Value)
audioOut = reverb(audioIn)
tools.notes: Output is stereo. For measured room acoustics convolve with an impulse response instead.

tools.name: shiftPitch
tools.description: Shifts the pitch of an audio signal by a number of semitones without changing its duration, using a phase vocoder with optional phase locking and formant preservation.
tools.usage:
audioOut = shiftPitch(audioIn, nsemitones)
audioOut = shiftPitch(___, Name=Value)
tools.notes: stretchAudio changes duration without changing pitch; both are used in audioDataAugmenter.

tools.name: stretchAudio
tools.description: Time-stretches audio by a speedup factor without changing pitch, using WSOLA or a phase vocoder.
tools.usage:
audioOut = stretchAudio(audioIn, alpha)
audioOut = stretchAudio(___, Name=Value)
tools.example:
y = stretchAudio(x, 1.25, Method="wsola");
sound(y, fs)
tools.notes: audioTimeScaler provides streaming time scaling.

tools.name: audioresample
tools.description: Converts the sample rate of audio signals with a high-quality polyphase design suited to audio, specifying input and output rates directly (including non-integer ratios such as 44.1 kHz to 48 kHz).
tools.usage:
y = audioresample(x, InputRate=fsIn, OutputRate=fsOut)
y = audioresample(___, Name=Value)
tools.example:
[x, fs] = audioread("speech_dft.wav");
y = audioresample(x, InputRate=fs, OutputRate=16000);
tools.notes: designAudioResampler returns a reusable resampler design; Signal Processing resample is the general-purpose alternative.

tools.name: audioDataAugmenter
tools.description: Creates a randomized augmentation pipeline for audio datasets (time stretch, pitch shift, volume control, additive noise, time shift and custom methods) to enlarge training data for machine and deep learning.
tools.usage:
aug = audioDataAugmenter(Name=Value)
data = augment(aug, audioIn, fs)

parameters.name: NumAugmentations
parameters.description: Number of augmented outputs per input.

tools.notes: addAugmentationMethod registers custom augmentations. Apply in a transformed audioDatastore for on-the-fly augmentation.

tools.name: detectSpeech
tools.description: Detects the boundaries of speech regions in an audio signal using an energy and spectral-spread thresholding algorithm, returning start/end sample indices; plots the result when called without outputs.
tools.usage:
idx = detectSpeech(audioIn, fs)
[idx, thresholds] = detectSpeech(audioIn, fs, Name=Value)
detectSpeech(___)

parameters.name: MergeDistance
parameters.description: Merge regions closer than this many samples.

parameters.name: Thresholds
parameters.description: Precomputed thresholds for consistent detection across files.

tools.notes: detectspeechnn uses a pretrained neural network (VAD) for better robustness in noise; voiceActivityDetector works frame by frame.

tools.name: classifySound
tools.description: Classifies sounds in an audio signal with the pretrained YAMNet network over the AudioSet ontology, returning detected sound classes, their time regions and a results table.
tools.usage:
sounds = classifySound(audioIn, fs)
[sounds, timestamps, resultsTable] = classifySound(audioIn, fs, Name=Value)
tools.example:
[x, fs] = audioread("multipleSounds-16-16-mono-18secs.wav");
[sounds, ts] = classifySound(x, fs)
tools.notes: Requires the YAMNet pretrained model (Deep Learning Toolbox and a one-time download). yamnetGraph explores the ontology.

tools.name: audioPretrainedNetwork
tools.description: Loads a pretrained audio neural network such as YAMNet (sound classification), VGGish or OpenL3 (embeddings), CREPE (pitch) or the VAD network, returning a dlnetwork ready for inference or transfer learning.
tools.usage: [net, classNames] = audioPretrainedNetwork(name)
tools.notes: Introduced R2024a, replacing individual loader functions. Use the matching *Preprocess functions (yamnetPreprocess, vggishPreprocess, openl3Preprocess, crepePreprocess).

tools.name: vggishEmbeddings
tools.description: Extracts 128-dimensional VGGish feature embeddings from audio, providing compact learned features for classification, clustering or similarity tasks with small datasets.
tools.usage:
embeddings = vggishEmbeddings(audioIn, fs)
embeddings = vggishEmbeddings(___, Name=Value)

parameters.name: ApplyPCA
parameters.description: Apply the PCA postprocessing used by the original model.

tools.example:
emb = vggishEmbeddings(x, fs);
featureVector = mean(emb, 1);
tools.notes: openl3Embeddings provides larger (512/6144-D) embeddings; speakerEmbeddings targets speaker identity.

tools.name: speech2text
tools.description: Transcribes speech in an audio signal to text using a pretrained model (e.g. wav2vec 2.0, Emformer) or a third-party cloud speech service configured through speechClient.
tools.usage:
transcript = speech2text(audioIn, fs)
transcript = speech2text(audioIn, fs, Client=client)
[transcript, rawOutput] = speech2text(___)

parameters.name: Client
parameters.description: speechClient object selecting the model or service (e.g. speechClient("wav2vec2.0"), speechClient("Google")).

tools.notes: Pretrained models need their support package; cloud services need credentials and send audio off the machine. text2speech performs the inverse.

tools.name: text2speech
tools.description: Synthesizes speech audio from text using a supported pretrained model or third-party speech service selected with speechClient.
tools.usage:
[speech, fs] = text2speech(text)
[speech, fs] = text2speech(text, Client=client)

parameters.name: Client
parameters.description: speechClient object for the model/service and its options.

tools.example:
[y, fs] = text2speech("Signal acquired and processed.");
sound(y, fs)
tools.notes: Cloud clients require account setup; check which built-in model is available in your release.

tools.name: ivectorSystem
tools.description: Creates an i-vector system for speaker recognition, verification or diarization and other audio classification tasks; it trains a universal background model and total variability space, then enrolls, verifies and identifies labels.
tools.usage:
ivs = ivectorSystem(Name=Value)
trainExtractor(ivs, data)
trainClassifier(ivs, data, labels)
enroll(ivs, data, label)
[tf, score] = verify(ivs, x, label)

parameters.name: DetectSpeech
parameters.description: Apply speech detection before feature extraction.

tools.notes: speakerRecognition provides a pretrained speaker recognition system.

tools.name: gtcc
tools.description: Extracts gammatone cepstral coefficients (GTCC), log energy, delta and delta-delta per frame; an auditory-model alternative to MFCC that is often more robust in noise.
tools.usage:
coeffs = gtcc(audioIn, fs)
[coeffs, delta, deltaDelta, loc] = gtcc(___, Name=Value)

parameters.name: NumCoeffs / FrequencyRange / FilterDomain
parameters.description: Coefficient count (default 13), band range and filtering domain.

tools.example:
[c, d, dd] = gtcc(x, fs, NumCoeffs=20);
features = [c d dd];
tools.notes: audioFeatureExtractor can compute gtcc alongside other features while sharing intermediate results.

tools.name: spectralCentroid
tools.description: Computes the spectral centroid (brightness) of audio per frame from a signal or a precomputed spectrogram. Part of a family of spectral shape descriptors used for timbre and classification features.
tools.usage:
centroid = spectralCentroid(x, f)
centroid = spectralCentroid(x, fs, Name=Value)

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: Audio signal (with fs) or spectrogram (with frequency vector f).

parameters.name: Window / OverlapLength / Range / SpectrumType
parameters.description: Frame settings, frequency range and "power" or "magnitude" spectrum.

tools.example:
c = spectralCentroid(x, fs, Window=hann(1024, "periodic"), OverlapLength=512);
plot(c)
tools.notes: Related: spectralFlux, spectralRolloffPoint, spectralSpread, spectralSlope, spectralDecrease (Audio Toolbox) and spectralCrest/Flatness/Entropy/Kurtosis/Skewness (Signal Processing Toolbox).

tools.name: spectralFlux
tools.description: Computes spectral flux, the frame-to-frame change of the spectrum, which peaks at note onsets and transients; useful for onset detection and rhythm features.
tools.usage:
flux = spectralFlux(x, f)
flux = spectralFlux(x, fs, Name=Value)
tools.example:
flux = spectralFlux(x, fs);
[~, onsets] = findpeaks(flux, MinPeakHeight=mean(flux) + 2*std(flux));
tools.notes: Works on audio or on precomputed spectrograms (then pass the frequency vector).

tools.name: harmonicRatio
tools.description: Computes the harmonic ratio per frame, the proportion of energy in harmonic (periodic) components, distinguishing voiced speech and tonal music from noise.
tools.usage:
hr = harmonicRatio(audioIn, fs)
hr = harmonicRatio(___, Name=Value)
tools.example:
hr = harmonicRatio(x, fs);
voiced = hr > 0.8;
tools.notes: Available as a feature in audioFeatureExtractor.

tools.name: audioDelta
tools.description: Computes delta (time-derivative) features using the standard regression formula over a window of frames; applying it twice gives delta-delta features.
tools.usage:
delta = audioDelta(x)
delta = audioDelta(x, deltaWindowLength)
tools.notes: Mirrors the delta computation of mfcc/gtcc so custom features stay consistent.

tools.name: integratedLoudness
tools.description: Measures integrated loudness (LUFS) and loudness range (LU) of an audio signal according to ITU-R BS.1770 / EBU R 128, for broadcast and streaming loudness normalization.
tools.usage:
loudness = integratedLoudness(audioIn, fs)
[loudness, loudnessRange] = integratedLoudness(audioIn, fs, channelWeights)
tools.notes: loudnessMeter provides momentary/short-term loudness for streaming; acousticLoudness computes psychoacoustic (sone) loudness.

tools.name: loudnessMeter
tools.description: System object implementing a standard-compliant (ITU-R BS.1770-4, EBU R 128) loudness meter that returns momentary, short-term and integrated loudness, loudness range and true-peak values for streaming audio.
tools.usage:
loudMtr = loudnessMeter(Name=Value)
[momentary, shortTerm, integrated, range, peak] = loudMtr(audioIn)
tools.notes: Call reset between independent programs.

tools.name: splMeter
tools.description: System object measuring sound pressure level with time weighting (fast, slow, impulse) and frequency weighting (A, C, Z), returning instantaneous, equivalent (Leq), peak and maximum levels from calibrated microphone signals.
tools.usage:
SPL = splMeter(Name=Value)
[LT, Leq, Lpeak, Lmax] = SPL(audioIn)

parameters.name: CalibrationFactor / PressureReference / SampleRate
parameters.description: Calibration to pascals, reference pressure and rate.

tools.notes: calibrateMicrophone computes the calibration factor from a known reference tone.

tools.name: impzest
tools.description: Estimates the impulse response of an audio system (room, loudspeaker, device) from an excitation signal and its recorded response, typically using exponential sweeps (sweeptone) or maximum length sequences (mls).
tools.usage:
ir = impzest(excitation, recording)
ir = impzest(___, Name=Value)

parameters.name: excitation
parameters.description: Excitation signal from sweeptone or mls.

parameters.name: WarmupRuns / ExcitationLevel
parameters.description: Options matching how the excitation was played.

tools.notes: sweeptone(sweepDuration, silenceDuration, fs) generates exponential sweeps; the Impulse Response Measurer app automates acquisition.

tools.name: acousticLoudness
tools.description: Computes perceived loudness (sone), specific loudness per critical band and percentile loudness from calibrated sound pressure signals according to ISO 532-1 (Zwicker) or ISO 532-2 (Moore-Glasberg).
tools.usage:
loudness = acousticLoudness(audioIn, fs)
[loudness, specificLoudness, perc] = acousticLoudness(___, Name=Value)
acousticLoudness(___)
tools.example:
p = calibratedSignalPa;              % pressure in pascals
[N, Nspec] = acousticLoudness(p, fs, TimeVarying=true);
tools.notes: Related psychoacoustic metrics: acousticSharpness, acousticRoughness, acousticFluctuation.

tools.name: sofaread
tools.description: Reads a SOFA (Spatially Oriented Format for Acoustics) file, such as head-related transfer function (HRTF) or room impulse response sets, into a convention-specific MATLAB object.
tools.usage: s = sofaread(filename)
tools.notes: sofawrite writes SOFA files; interpolateHRTF interpolates HRTFs for arbitrary directions for binaural rendering.
